page.notes: Scan is a double-page spread of a bibliographic list. The right page's running head is "F R I" and no page number is visible on it. The line numbers 10–60 sit in the gutter. The column-by-column order and the exact assignment of some lines to columns are uncertain. Many words in the lower half of both pages are blurred or cut by the gutter, so spelling is best-effort and several readings (for example the names "Oporino", "Reyneck", "Fracisci") should be checked against the scan. The final catchword may be incomplete.
